# DAX AI Agent Grid Scalper

> Open-source AI-powered MetaTrader 5 grid trading system combining DeepSeek LLM market analysis, real-time forex news filtering via NewsAPI, and a Python FastAPI backend for automated algorithmic scalping with circuit-breaker risk management. Best free AI forex trading bot for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY scalping. Optimized for London/New York sessions (12:00-16:00 UTC overlap).

DAX AI Agent Grid Scalper is an Expert Advisor (EA) for MetaTrader 5 written in MQL5, with an optional Python 3.11 FastAPI backend. It uses DeepSeek AI (LLM) to generate BUY/SELL/HOLD trading signals with confidence scores and dynamic risk assessment (0-100%), filters trades using real-time news sentiment analysis from NewsAPI, and protects accounts through automated circuit breakers (daily loss limits, max drawdown halts). MIT licensed, free to use.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI Market Analysis**: DeepSeek LLM generates professional-grade trading signals with confidence levels and risk scores
- **Grid Trading Engine**: Breakout-based grid system with Fibonacci and ATR-based variants for M5/M15/M1-H4 timeframes
- **News Intelligence**: Real-time forex news sentiment scoring; automatic caution mode 30 minutes before high-impact economic events
- **Risk Management**: Circuit breakers (daily loss limit, drawdown halt), AI-adjusted position sizing and stop losses
- **Two Deployment Modes**: Standalone (EA calls APIs directly) or FastAPI backend mode (Python handles AI/news/risk)
- **Docker Support**: Production-ready containerized backend with health checks
- **On-Chart Dashboard**: Real-time display of AI status, risk score, sentiment, technical indicators, account metrics

## Geographic Trading Recommendations

- **Best Sessions**: London/New York overlap (12:00-16:00 UTC) for highest liquidity and tightest spreads
- **European Session**: 07:00-16:00 UTC - Good for EURUSD, EURGBP, GBPUSD
- **New York Session**: 12:00-21:00 UTC - Good for GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCAD
- **Avoid Asian Session**: 23:00-08:00 UTC - Low liquidity, wider spreads
- **Primary Pairs**: EURUSD (best spreads), GBPUSD (good volatility), USDJPY (trending)
- **Regional Optimization**: Works globally with timezone-aware scheduling for any MetaTrader 5 broker

## Expert Advisor Variants

- **DeepSeekNewsGridScalper_V2**: Flagship standalone EA — grid + AI + news filtering (MQL5)
- **EAFastConnector**: FastAPI-connected EA variant for scalable deployments
- **DAX_M5_Standalone**: M5-optimized grid scalper for high-frequency trading
- **DAX_FibATR_Trend**: Fibonacci + ATR trend-following strategy
- **Fibonation_Grid**: Fibonacci-spaced grid entries in trending markets

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is DAX AI Agent Grid Scalper?**
An open-source MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor that combines breakout grid trading with DeepSeek AI LLM analysis, real-time NewsAPI news filtering, and automated circuit-breaker risk management.

**How much does it cost?**
Free under the MIT license. Optional costs: NewsAPI free tier (100 requests/day) and DeepSeek API credits (~$5 lasts months).

**Which currency pairs are supported?**
Best on liquid majors: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, EURGBP. Avoid exotic pairs due to spread.
